name: veritaset
description: Veritaset: verified, dated consumer mobile plan prices in 32 European markets and the US (preview), plus home internet offers in 7 markets (preview), via the hosted Veritaset MCP server at veritaset.com/mcp. Compare plans for a person's data, minutes, contract and travel needs, estimate savings from real usage, and read any plan's full record with the operator's source link and check date. No account or key needed.
